summary: The current advice is to wait before buying anything in India, though Hindustan Copper is the preferred choice if buying anyway, and to buy JPMorgan Chase in the United States. Analysts are discussing how fees and taxes on a ten thousand rupee trade in Reliance Industries would cost about thirty-eight rupees plus twenty percent tax on short-term gains. They also note that Hindustan Copper had a forty-nine percent operating margin last quarter but has fallen ninety-seven percent from its all-time high.
